title: Matthew Chapter 21 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Matthew chapter 21 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Matthew Chapter 21 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Matthew Chapter 21.

questions.question: Who did Jesus send to fetch the ass and the colt?
questions.explanation: Jesus sent two disciples to fetch the ass and the colt as stated in Matthew 21:1.

questions.question: What were the disciples instructed to say if anyone questioned them about the animals?
options: The Lord hath need of them
questions.correctAnswer: The Lord hath need of them
questions.explanation: The disciples were instructed to say, 'The Lord hath need of them' if anyone questioned them, as per Matthew 21:3.

questions.question: What was fulfilled by Jesus riding into Jerusalem on an ass and a colt?
questions.explanation: The event was done to fulfill what was spoken by the prophet, indicating it was a prophecy as mentioned in Matthew 21:4.

questions.question: What did the multitude spread in the way as Jesus entered Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The multitude spread their garments in the way as Jesus entered Jerusalem, according to Matthew 21:8.

questions.question: What did the people shout as Jesus entered Jerusalem?
options: Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: Blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord
questions.explanation: The multitude cried, 'Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord' as stated in Matthew 21:9.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus cast out those who sold and bought in the temple.
questions.explanation: Jesus cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple, as mentioned in Matthew 21:12.

questions.question: True or False: The temple was referred to as a den of thieves by Jesus.
questions.explanation: Jesus referred to the temple as a den of thieves, indicating displeasure at its misuse in Matthew 21:13.

questions.question: What did the blind and lame do when they came to Jesus in the temple?
questions.explanation: Jesus healed the blind and the lame who came to him in the temple, as stated in Matthew 21:14.

questions.question: What did the chief priests and scribes feel when they saw the wonderful things Jesus did?
questions.explanation: The chief priests and scribes were sore displeased when they saw the wonderful things that Jesus did, according to Matthew 21:15.

questions.question: What did Jesus say to the chief priests when they questioned him?
options: I will tell you by what authority
questions.explanation: Jesus stated that he would not tell them by what authority he did these things after they could not answer his question, as per Matthew 21:27.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus used a parable about two sons to illustrate obedience.
questions.explanation: Jesus used a parable about a certain man with two sons to illustrate obedience and response to authority, as seen in Matthew 21:28.

questions.question: In what order did the events begin in Matthew 21?
options: Jesus casting out buyers and sellers
Jesus sending disciples for the colt
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus sending disciples for the colt
questions.explanation: The first event described is Jesus sending two disciples to fetch the ass and the colt in Matthew 21:1.

medium.title: Matthew Chapter 21 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Matthew Chapter 21 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What did Jesus instruct his disciples to bring to him as he approached Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Jesus instructed his disciples to find an ass and her colt, as stated in Matthew 21:2, 'Go into the village... ye shall find an ass tied, and a colt with her.'

questions.question: What did the multitude shout as Jesus entered Jerusalem?
options: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord
Glory to God in the highest
questions.correctAnswer: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord
questions.explanation: The crowds cried out 'Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord' as noted in Matthew 21:9, which shows their recognition of Jesus as the Messiah.

questions.question: True or False: Jesus overturned the tables of the moneychangers in the temple.
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:12 states, 'Jesus went into the temple... and overthrew the tables of the moneychangers,' indicating that this action took place.

questions.question: What lesson does Matthew 21:21 teach about faith?
options: Faith is only for the strong
questions.explanation: In Matthew 21:21, Jesus says that if one has faith and does not doubt, they can move mountains, illustrating the power of true faith.

questions.question: How do the actions of the first son in Jesus' parable reflect a biblical virtue?
questions.explanation: The first son initially refused to work in the vineyard but later repented and obeyed his father's request, exemplifying the virtue of obedience (Matthew 21:29).

questions.question: True or False: The chief priests and Pharisees believed John's baptism was from heaven.
questions.explanation: The chief priests and Pharisees did not believe John's baptism was from heaven, as indicated by their reasoning in Matthew 21:25-26.

questions.question: What will happen to those who fall on the stone according to Matthew 21:44?
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:44 states, 'And whosoever shall fall on this stone shall be broken,' indicating the consequences of rejecting Christ.

questions.question: What does Matthew 21:22 promise regarding prayer?
options: You will receive everything you ask for
questions.correctAnswer: You will receive everything you ask for
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:22 promises, 'And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive,' emphasizing the importance of faith in prayer.

questions.question: What did Jesus say would happen if the disciples had faith according to Matthew 21:21?
questions.explanation: In Matthew 21:21, Jesus highlights that with faith, they could command mountains to be removed, showing the power of belief.

questions.question: True or False: The second son in the parable went to work in the vineyard after saying he would.
questions.explanation: The second son said he would go but did not actually go to work in the vineyard, as explained in Matthew 21:30.

questions.question: What did Jesus state about the kingdom of God in Matthew 21:43?
options: It will be taken from the Jews
It will be given to the Gentiles
questions.correctAnswer: It will be taken from the Jews
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:43 indicates that 'the kingdom of God shall be taken from you,' referring to the religious leaders who rejected Him.

questions.question: In the parable of the vineyard, what did the husbandmen do to the son?
questions.explanation: The husbandmen killed the son, as noted in Matthew 21:39, showing their rejection of the heir to the vineyard.

hard.title: Matthew Chapter 21 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Matthew Chapter 21.

questions.question: What did Jesus instruct his disciples to do when they came to Bethphage?
options: Find an ass and a colt
questions.correctAnswer: Find an ass and a colt
questions.explanation: Jesus sent his disciples to find an ass and a colt, as stated in Matthew 21:2.

questions.question: What was the reaction of the multitude when Jesus entered Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: The multitudes cried out 'Hosanna to the Son of David' in celebration, as noted in Matthew 21:9.

questions.question: Which two groups were displeased by the wonderful things Jesus did in the temple?
questions.explanation: The chief priests and scribes were sore displeased by the miracles and praises of Jesus, as seen in Matthew 21:15.

questions.question: What did Jesus say would happen to the fig tree that bore no fruit?
options: It would produce fruit next year
questions.explanation: Jesus cursed the fig tree, stating that it would never bear fruit again, leading to its withering, as described in Matthew 21:19.

questions.question: According to Jesus, what must one have to perform miracles such as moving mountains?
questions.explanation: Jesus emphasized the importance of faith when he said that with faith, one could do great things, as indicated in Matthew 21:21.

questions.question: What authority did the chief priests and elders question Jesus about?
questions.explanation: They questioned Jesus about his authority to teach and perform miracles in the temple, as seen in Matthew 21:23.

questions.question: In the parable of the wicked husbandmen, what did the husbandmen do to the owner's son?
questions.explanation: The husbandmen killed the son, thinking to seize his inheritance, as stated in Matthew 21:38.

questions.question: What does the 'stone which the builders rejected' refer to in Jesus' teaching?
questions.explanation: Jesus uses this metaphor to refer to himself as the cornerstone, which the builders (religious leaders) rejected, mentioned in Matthew 21:42.

questions.question: True or False: The kingdom of God will be taken from the chief priests and given to a nation producing its fruits.
questions.explanation: Jesus declared that the kingdom of God would be taken from them and given to another nation, as stated in Matthew 21:43.

questions.question: True or False: The chief priests and Pharisees did not understand the parables spoken by Jesus.
questions.explanation: The chief priests and Pharisees perceived that Jesus spoke of them, indicating they understood his implication, as noted in Matthew 21:45.

questions.question: Which Old Testament prophet is referenced in Matthew 21:5 regarding the coming king?
questions.explanation: The prophecy about the king coming meekly on an ass references Zechariah, fulfilling the prophecy in Matthew 21:5.

questions.question: In the vineyard parable, what did the householder do after planting the vineyard?
options: He went into a far country
questions.correctAnswer: He went into a far country
questions.explanation: After planting the vineyard, the householder went into a far country, as mentioned in Matthew 21:33.

questions.question: What does the Greek word for 'Hosanna' mean, as used by the multitude?
questions.explanation: The term 'Hosanna' means 'save now,' reflecting the multitude's plea for salvation, as they cried out in Matthew 21:9.

theological.title: Matthew Chapter 21 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Matthew Chapter 21 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What does Matthew 21:5 indicate about the nature of Jesus as King?
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:5 states, 'Tell ye the daughter of Sion, Behold, thy King cometh unto thee, meek, and sitting upon an ass, and a colt the foal of an ass.' This reveals that Jesus embodies humility as a king, contrasting with worldly expectations of royalty.

questions.question: What does Jesus' action of casting out the moneychangers from the temple signify?
questions.explanation: In Matthew 21:12-13, Jesus 'cast out all them that sold and bought in the temple' and declared it a 'den of thieves', signifying His judgment against the corruption present in worship practices.

questions.question: Which attribute of God is demonstrated by Jesus healing the blind and lame in the temple?
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:14 describes Jesus healing the blind and lame, reflecting God's attribute of mercy, as He cares for the marginalized and suffering.

questions.question: What doctrinal insight can be drawn from Matthew 21:22 about prayer?
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:22 says, 'And all things, whatsoever ye shall ask in prayer, believing, ye shall receive.' This emphasizes the necessity of faith in the efficacy of prayer.

questions.question: How does Matthew 21:41 connect to the theme of divine judgment?
options: It shows God's approval of all actions
It warns of punishment for wickedness
It suggests all will be saved
questions.correctAnswer: It warns of punishment for wickedness
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:41 states that the vineyard owner will 'miserably destroy those wicked men', highlighting the theme of divine judgment against unfaithfulness.

questions.question: What does the parable of the two sons in Matthew 21:28-31 reveal about repentance?
options: Only the first son is saved
questions.explanation: In Matthew 21:31, Jesus indicates that the first son, who initially refused but later obeyed, represents those who truly do the will of the Father, showing that actions reveal genuine faith.

questions.question: What combined teaching do verses 10-11 convey about public perception of Jesus?
options: He was seen as a prophet
He was considered a political figure
questions.correctAnswer: He was seen as a prophet
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:10-11 shows that the crowd was moved and recognized Jesus as 'the prophet of Nazareth of Galilee', indicating that His ministry was acknowledged as prophetic.

questions.question: How does Matthew 21:43 connect to the theme of the Kingdom of God?
options: It will be given to all nations
It will remain with the Jews
questions.correctAnswer: It will be given to all nations
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:43 states, 'The kingdom of God shall be taken from you, and given to a nation bringing forth the fruits thereof', indicating the expansion of God's kingdom beyond Israel.

questions.question: What does the withering of the fig tree in Matthew 21:19 signify?
questions.explanation: In Matthew 21:19, Jesus' curse on the fig tree symbolizes judgment on Israel for not bearing spiritual fruit, illustrating the consequences of unfaithfulness.

questions.question: What does Matthew 21:16 teach about the praise of children?
options: It is a sign of innocence
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:16 shows Jesus affirming that the praise of children is divinely ordained, saying, 'Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings thou hast perfected praise', underscoring the value of childlike faith.

questions.question: How do verses 25-27 illustrate the challenge of acknowledging truth?
options: Fear of man can lead to denial
questions.correctAnswer: Fear of man can lead to denial
questions.explanation: In Matthew 21:25-27, the chief priests and elders hesitate to answer Jesus about John's baptism due to fear of the people's opinion, demonstrating how fear can lead to avoidance of truth.

questions.question: What significance does Jesus' question in Matthew 21:24 hold for authority?
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:24 shows Jesus' method of questioning the authority of the chief priests, suggesting that true authority ultimately derives from divine origin, as He challenges their understanding.

questions.question: What does the reference to the stone in Matthew 21:42 signify in relation to Jesus?
questions.explanation: In Matthew 21:42, Jesus refers to the stone 'which the builders rejected', indicating His own rejection by the religious leaders, yet He becomes the cornerstone of faith, fulfilling prophetic scripture.

questions.question: What does Matthew 21:37 teach about God's ultimate communication with humanity?
questions.explanation: Matthew 21:37 states, 'But last of all he sent unto them his son', illustrating that God's ultimate revelation and communication to humanity is through Jesus Christ, His Son.
